statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let budget := fun x : ℕ => (x : ℝ) * Real.log (x : ℝ); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let primes := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.Ioc x ((2*x)^2+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p^100000 ≤ (2*x)^132301); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); let model := fun a x : ℕ => ∑ p ∈ primes x, ((window x p).card : ℝ) * ((roots a p).card : ℝ) / p * Real.log (p : ℝ); ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ x ≥ X, model 1 x ≤ (2/5 : ℝ)*budget x

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0009 · 把移动窗口零频主项压到 2/5 预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0009 · Bound the moving-window zero mode by 2/5

brief.zh: 窗口至多有 x 项。将根加权调和和的上界乘以 x。
brief.en: The window contains at most x terms. Multiply the logarithmic harmonic sum by x.
